translation_notes: Translation of the two literal SPARQL strings to s{ } is mechanical and done in translated.ldpy (s{ SELECT ?s ?p ?o WHERE { ?s ?p ?o . } } and, with @prefix foaf: added, s{ SELECT DISTINCT ?person WHERE { ?person a foaf:Person . } }), called as sparql(g) in place of g.query(sparql).

The driver cannot exercise this region: `rdfeval check` fails before either version runs, with ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'sqlalchemy' (original.py imports sqlalchemy.engine.URL and vitalgraph.store.store.VitalGraphSQLStore, neither installed, and vitalgraph's own store additionally needs a live PostgreSQL instance at g.open(db_url)).

Even with those dependencies installed, main() takes no argument -- the graph is created and opened INSIDE the function against a hardcoded Postgres DSN -- so the fixture.ttl mechanism (which calls entry with one fixture-graph argument) could not drive it without restructuring main() to accept a graph, which the no-refactoring rule forbids.
Per AGENT_BATCH.md 'quand ca ne passe pas' #1: classified excluded rather than forced green, to avoid another hollow-graph pass in this stratum.
